description: Activate when: user asks why a team keeps doing the wrong thing despite training; user is designing compensation, bonuses, or commissions; user says 'people are gaming the metric' or 'our OKRs aren't working'; user wants to fix a performance management system; user asks what incentives are driving a behavior; user is drafting contracts or platform rules to shape behavior. Do NOT activate when: the situation is clearly individual misconduct with no systemic pattern; user wants psychological persuasion tactics rather than structural system design. More: deciqai.com/c/incentive-design

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
